title: Fallout playbook visuals — throttling & connection degradation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, playbook-style visual asset suite for onboarding docs and quickstart screens that explains how the Redwood platform behaves under request fallout scenarios: rate throttling, request timeouts, and transient connection failures. Goal: a single-page visual module (three sequential panels) plus 6 micro-illustrations and 3 screenshot overlays that can be reused in docs, the Quickstart modal, and the Console "error helper" component. The assets should emphasize actionable user steps (e.g., check retry-after header, reduce batch size, switch to dedicated capacity) and include modular microcopy variants for product, doc, and email contexts.
acceptance_criteria: One master Figma page with: playbook flow (3 panels), 6 micro-illustrations (icons + small scenes), and 3 Console screenshot overlays annotated
Microcopy matrix covering: short (40-80 chars), medium (80-180 chars), and long (180-300 chars) variants for each error type
Accessibility pass: contrast >= 4.5 for body text, color alternatives for the three severity states, and alt-text / ARIA suggestions for each graphic
Exported PNGs/SVGs at 1x, 2x with clear naming convention and a lightweight JSON manifest for developers
Design handoff notes and a linked GitHub PR that adds the assets to docs site and Quickstart modal

Console: request details drawer showing latency histogram and retry count
Quickstart modal: in-context helper with a small inline playbook panel
design_notes: Visual language: modern editorial — single accent color per severity + neutral supporting palette; use rounded corner cards to match Console UI
Icons: custom line icons with 2px strokes; include motion frames for hero animation (fade + subtle vertical nudge) for the Quickstart modal
Microcopy rules: prefer imperative verbs, surface one recommended action and one 'next-best' action, show code snippet where applicable
Tone: calm, operational — avoid alarmist language. Use 'temporary slowdown' rather than 'throttled' in user-facing microcopy when possible
Localization: reserve extra space for German/Spanish expansions (~30% longer); provide translation keys in handoff
qa_checks: Verify exported PNGs match naming convention and include 2x variants
Accessibility: color contrast verification and keyboard focus order for interactive Quickstart animation
Copy accuracy check against Docs microcopy matrix
Console overlay alignment: annotations must align with real Console elements at 1400px width
